title: BTX
description: &bBTX&r is a high-grade powerful fuel which generates a lot of power when burnt. An important use of BTX is in the creation of &6Crystalline Fullerite&r and &6Hard Plastic Bars&r. BTX can be obtained from a &3Hydrotreater&r, but it is more efficient to use &bReformate&r from a &3Vacuum Refinery&r.
